u0: Initial state: the exit has not yet been reached, no box pickup has advanced the machine, and the siren has not rung while the box was absent. Head toward the exit; if the siren rings before the box has been picked up, switch to getting the box. Picking up the box successfully advances to u2.
u1: The siren has rung while the box was not being carried, so the pickup obligation is now active. Do not finish at the exit yet: the next objective is to pick up the box at least once. Doing so advances to u2; until then, remain in this state even if the siren stops.
u2: The box has been picked up at least once, satisfying the pickup-related progress tracked by the machine. The remaining objective is simply to reach the exit. The box may still be held or may have been dropped or fallen; that no longer changes the state.
u3: Terminal success state: the exit has been reached and the episode ends. No further objective or action is needed.
